errors.evidence: The description claims the chart shows a percentage distribution, but the y-axis values are absolute counts of respondents (e.g., 19, 37, 3, 5). There is no percentage symbol shown on the axis or labels.
The description states the vertical axis shows percentage values, but it actually represents absolute numerical counts. There is no '%' unit indicated on the chart.
The description incorrectly states the value is 37%. The chart shows the value is 37, which is an absolute count, not a percentage.
The description incorrectly states the value is 19%. The chart shows the value is 19, an absolute count.
The description incorrectly states the value is 5%. The chart shows the value is 5, an absolute count.
The description incorrectly states the value is 3%. The chart shows the value is 3, an absolute count.
